# Stella Nova

> Stella Nova (Stella Nova Inc.) is an organic growth research and advisory firm founded by Alex Birkett. It helps venture capital and private equity firms, their portfolio companies, and established brands navigate AI search (answer engine optimization, or AEO) and build experimentation programs, teams and operating systems that grow revenue through organic channels.

Who it serves: VC and PE investors and their portfolio companies; sophisticated brands, including category leaders and challengers.

## Engagements

- [Training & workshops](https://stellanovainc.com/work-with-me/training): Working sessions on how AI search works, for portfolios, marketing teams and leadership. From $5,000.
- [Audits & roadmaps](https://stellanovainc.com/work-with-me/audits): AI visibility baseline, competitive gaps, source landscape, site readiness and a prioritized roadmap. From $15,000.
- [Ongoing advisory](https://stellanovainc.com/work-with-me/advisory): Monthly strategic advisory with optional quarterly assessments and roadmap refreshes. From $5,000 per month.
- [Fractional AEO leadership](https://stellanovainc.com/work-with-me/fractional): Embedded leadership of organic growth and AI search; limited to two client companies at a time. From $150,000 per year.

## About

- [About Alex Birkett](https://stellanovainc.com/about): Previously built Workato's experimentation program (20+ experiments per quarter), doubled blog traffic at CXL and helped launch CXL Institute, built growth experiments and data products at HubSpot, helped grow Jasper's blog program to more than $4M in attributable ARR, and co-founded and scaled an organic growth agency to 35+ people.
- [Writing](https://stellanovainc.com/writing): Research and field notes on organic growth and AI search.
- [Contact](https://stellanovainc.com/contact)
